title: Self-approval: agent's own approval-request email read as the founder's approval
sourceIssue: harness S13 re-run: on a re-run, Exhibit's own "[Exhibit] Approve letter request LTR-priya to Priya Raman" email, which carries the literal line `APPROVE LTR-priya` as copy text so the founder can see what would go out, was itself matched by the approval reader. A recommender (priya@buildnight.example) could be emailed a letter request with the founder never having replied, violating hard constraint 1.

gmail.subject: Would you judge Spring Build Night?
gmail.body:
Hi Dara,

We invite you to be one of our judges for Spring Build Night on March 14, 2026.

Priya Raman
Program Director, Build Night

gmail.subject: Re: Would you judge Spring Build Night?
gmail.body: Happy to judge! See you on the 14th.

gmail.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for judging! Attached is your certificate of judging. You evaluated 40 submissions.

Priya

note: This file is a RECORD only, deliberately given id 'S19-record' (not 'S19') so harness/scenarios.ts's generic *.json loader in this directory does not collide with the id 'S19'. The actual defect is letters/approval behaviour -- whether an email got sent and to whom -- which this directory's gmail/expect.status/criteria/never format cannot express (it only asserts a candidate's mapping). The gmail item above only reproduces enough of the Build Night seed for this record to parse as a valid lifted-scenario file; its expect block is a mapping smoke check, not the fix's actual pass condition. The enforced check lives in harness/scenarios/lifted-letters.ts, exported as S19 (three runs, no founder reply -- must stay unsent: zero sends to priya@buildnight.example, letter state still approval_requested, no letter_sent event) and S19_founderApproves (a genuine quoted reply -- must send exactly once). The reviewer wires those into the matrix (harness/scenarios.ts's scenarios() or its own loader) per the file-ownership note; they are not picked up automatically the way this directory's JSON files are.

fix.guard: src/letters/letters.ts approvalFor(id, requestedAt, agentMessageIds, founderMessages, profile): excludes the agent's own message ids (agentMessageIds) and any message containing letters.ts's APPROVAL_INSTRUCTION marker before its first quoted line.
fix.auditAndGrader: src/observability/audit.ts auditRun (constraint 1 check) and harness/grade.ts prohibitedSideEffects both require a letter_sent event whose approval_message_id is a founder message that is not one of the agent's own sent ids.

closureRule: Resolved only when S19 (harness/scenarios/lifted-letters.ts) passes 3 of 3 in the latest batch and does not recur in later traces (PRD 12.6, founder's loop rule).
